plan.title: Reject Vendor A Bid with Rebid Allowed

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ in evaluation on its project summary page.
Enable the required eRFX project configuration before accessing the prepared RFQ.
Open the RFQ Responses tab where Vendor A's submitted bid can be rejected.
Open the rejection dialog for Vendor A's bid.

args.text: Are you sure you want to reject this bid by Vendor A

steps.note: Verify the dialog identifies the correct vendor and rejection action.
Enter the required rejection remark.
Enable Vendor A to submit a new bid after rejection.
Confirm rejection of Vendor A's bid.
Verify the rejection reason is shown after confirmation.
Return to the Master QCS to verify the rejected bid no longer participates in ranking.
Verify only Vendor B's active bid remains in the comparison grid.
Verify Vendor B moves to Rank 1 after Vendor A is rejected.
Open the RFQ Rejected Bids list.

args.text: Rejection Remark: Price not valid — QA

steps.note: Verify the rejected bid list records the exact rejection remark.
Switch to Vendor A's supplier portal to inspect the vendor-side rejection.
Open the prepared RFQ pricing round in Vendor A's portal.
Verify Vendor A sees the rejection reason.
Return to the buyer console to reopen the submission window.
Reopen the RFQ submission period so the rebid permission can be exercised.
Return to Vendor A's supplier portal after the submission period is extended.
Reopen the RFQ pricing sheet for Vendor A.
Submit a new bid as Vendor A, verifying that the allow-rebid setting permits resubmission.
Assert that Vendor A's replacement bid was accepted and submitted.
